title: A proposed decomposition of one stage task into several
description: What an agent hands back when asked to decompose a stage. The organization validates it against policies/task-synthesis.json and grafts what survives; nothing here is trusted because it parsed.

rationale.description: Why this split and not another. Recorded in history, because the next person to read the graph will want to know why the stage looks like this.

key.description: A local name used only to express dependencies between siblings. The organization assigns the real task ids.

produces.description: Artifact codes. Together the children must produce exactly what the parent owed.

depends_on.description: Sibling keys only. The parent already carries this change's outside dependencies.

definition_of_done.description: Predicate calls from the artifact model. An invented predicate is skipped by the evaluator, which makes it a definition of done that always passes, so these are checked.

coupled_surface.description: A shared contract this task edits. Two children may name the same surface; the graph will then refuse to run them at the same time.

risk.description: Defaults to the parent's. May be raised, never lowered: decomposing HIGH work into LOW pieces routes around the model floor and the approval gates one level down.

owns_paths.description: The files or globs this task will edit. Two tasks that name the same path will be ordered rather than run together, so this is how a split says which of its pieces are genuinely independent.

review.description: The decomposition review, per policies/decomposition-review.json. Required before grafting where the parent is HIGH or CRITICAL risk or holds a coupled surface; recommended otherwise. Every dimension is prose because there is no metric here and there will not be one -- a number for cohesion on a set of engineering tasks would be a heuristic wearing a decimal point.

reviewer.description: The role that reviewed it. Never the proposer: a role reviewing its own split will find it sound, for the same reason an author reviewing its own design does.

dimensions.description: One answer per dimension. A blank is refused; a lazy answer is refused by the person reading it, which is the honest division of labour here.

findings.description: What is wrong, where the verdict is not `sound`. Carried onto the grafted children's history so it is not lost at the graft.
